plan.archetype: Flexible burst damage with scalable defense
plan.bossPrep: Cross the 160-HP stun threshold quickly; carry sustained damage, upgraded Weak, and strong single-card defense for Ringing. Enter healthy with useful potions.
plan.summary: Prioritize efficient damage before elites, then scaling and better block. Preserve gold, remove Strikes gradually, and adapt to the selected pack rather than forcing poison.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling with burst damage and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Heal for Mailbox potions; establish poison early, cross the 160-HP stun threshold quickly, and preserve strong single-card defense for Ringing.
plan.summary: Prioritize poison acceleration and draw-block around Footwork. Remove Strikes and avoid energy congestion. Heal before the elite and boss; upgrade Footwork or Neutralize only when health and potions permit.

plan.archetype: Efficient stacked poison with draw and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Heal at the forced fire for two Mailbox potions. Establish poison and Footwork early; cross the 160-HP stun threshold. Favor Dash during Ringing.
plan.summary: Healing is mandatory. Mailbox potions offer immediate rescue and are absent from simulations. Improve cheap poison, acceleration, and draw-block; preserve Defends, remove Strikes, and avoid elites until recovery.
